title: Deeper/broader CAD-engine lineage and cross-layer writer evidence review
scope: OpenCADStudio codec/kernel dependency lineage and release/source provenance
Reported DWG writer failure and maintainer-reported repair evidence
Application-level self-consistency versus independent consumer acceptance
Implementation readiness and composed-only peer gate refinement

method.kind: Read-only review of current public primary project sources, dependency metadata, and issue history
method.limitations: GitHub main-branch sources are mutable. The reviewed OpenCADStudio manifest and lockfile reference different Git revisions; this review did not determine which exact source set produced any published binary. Issue #1078 contains reporter and maintainer statements, but the source-pair files and post-fix AutoCAD acceptance were not independently inspected. No behavior or semantic support is inferred from documentation alone.

sources.observed: The application advertises native DWG/DXF read-write, versioned save targets, 3D modeling/rendering, and platform release artifacts. These statements nominate an optional application/consumer route but do not qualify a particular binary.
The manifest declares Git dependencies on HakanSeven12/opencadcodec at rev a01df94 and HakanSeven12/opencadkernel at rev 0574444.

The lockfile records opencadcodec at commit 325fa98d2b881f48e106a830d5cf161624f63131 and opencadkernel at commit dfca3912228b19d4df25c8695b628ccb13497a78, differing from the short revisions in the retrieved manifest.
GitHub marks the repository as forked from hakanaktt/acadrust. It is a distinct maintained fork, not an independent parser lineage from ACadRust.

The project describes a separate geometry kernel with an optional ACIS SatDocument lift/lower layer, while also describing itself as early and noting that most operations are not yet written. It is not a DWG/DXF parser.

A reporter described AutoCAD RECOVER damage to Layout, MLeader, dynamic-block, handle/XDATA and XREF structures in specified builds. The maintainer later reported source changes and semantic counts for a supplied source pair, including an unchanged AcDs-section byte comparison on same-version saves. The pair and post-fix native acceptance were not independently verified.

The application documents its own document open/read/edit/save operations. Results produced by this application stack are application/self-consistency evidence and must not be counted as an independent parser or consumer vote.

The detailed format table marks DWG and DXF read/write, notes a DXF fallback for DWG, and marks ACIS SAT/SAB unsupported despite broader compatibility headlines. No implementation route was built or run.

assessment.lineageRule: OpenCADStudio/opencadcodec is ACadRust-fork lineage; count an application run as consumer/application evidence, not an independent codec vote. Record opencadkernel separately as a geometry layer, not a file parser.
assessment.sourceArtifactRule: Bind exact application release checksum, source commit, and resolved dependency lock before interpreting results. If manifest/lock/release provenance cannot be reconciled, mark PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE.
assessment.writerFailureRule: Use issue #1078 only as peer-specific failure taxonomy and test-design input. Separate same-version rewrite, cross-version rewrite, record/owner closure, opaque AcDs retention, and independent native acceptance. Do not infer a libdxfrw defect or require byte identity after version changes.
assessment.cadkernelRule: Do not treat CADKernel broad format claims as ACIS evidence; its own table marks SAT/SAB unsupported and DWG as DXF fallback.
assessment.researchStopRule: No new candidate runtime is warranted unless a pinned route can fill a named missing evidence layer; ordinary implementation slices remain local and fast.
